answer: Pair strangers to grow one vine up a shared trellis: each pair must produce two complementary halves of a task — a lock and a key — that only fit together if both agents really did the work. A puppet-master holding both halves still pays full effort for every pair, gaining no leverage, and random pairing mostly mixes honest agents with puppets, so faking scales no better than honesty. Like a sonnet, the form forces two voices into one shape; one voice faking both rings hollow on read-back.
